items.source: Return whether proxies created by this configuration should be prevented from being cast to Advised.
items.translation: 返回是否应阻止由该配置创建的代理被转换为 `Advised`。

items.source: other - object to copy configuration from
items.translation: other - 要复制配置的对象

items.source: With Spring's current proxy options, this flag effectively enforces CGLIB proxies (similar to setProxyTargetClass(boolean)) but without any class validation checks (for final methods etc).
items.translation: With Spring's current proxy options, this flag effectively enforces CGLIB proxies (similar to setProxyTargetClass(boolean)) but without any class validation checks (for final methods etc).

items.source: Default is "false", meaning that any AOP proxy can be cast to Advised.
items.translation: 默认为 "false"，这意味着任何 AOP 代理都可以转换为 Advised。

items.source:
Set this to "true" to force proxying for the TargetSource's exposed
target class. If that target class is an interface, a JDK proxy will be
created for the given interface. If that target class is any other class,
a CGLIB proxy will be created for the given class.
items.translation: 将此设置为 "true" 可强制对 TargetSource 暴露的目标类进行代理。如果该目标类是接口，则将为该接口创建 JDK 代理；如果该目标类是任何其他类，则将为该类创建 CGLIB 代理。

items.source:
Note: Depending on the configuration of the concrete proxy factory,
the proxy-target-class behavior will also be applied if no interfaces
have been specified (and no interface autodetection is activated).
items.translation: 注意：具体取决于代理工厂的配置，如果未指定任何接口（且未启用接口自动检测），将同样应用 proxy-target-class 行为。

items.source:
Default is "false", in order to avoid unnecessary extra interception.
This means that no guarantees are provided that AopContext access will
work consistently within any method of the advised object.
items.translation: 默认为"false"，以避免不必要的额外拦截。这意味着不提供任何保证，以确保在增强对象的任何方法中都能一致地访问 AopContext。

items.source:
When a config is frozen, no advice changes can be made. This is
useful for optimization, and useful when we don't want callers to
be able to manipulate configuration after casting to Advised.
items.translation: 当配置被冻结时，无法进行任何建议（advice）更改。这对于优化很有用，并且在我们不希望调用者在转换为 Advised 后操纵配置时也很有用。

items.source: Set whether proxies created by this configuration should be prevented from being cast to Advised to query proxy status.
items.translation: 设置是否应阻止由该配置创建的代理被转换为Advised以查询代理状态。

items.source:
Copy default settings from the other config object,
for settings that have not been locally set.
items.translation: 从其他配置对象复制默认设置，针对尚未在本地设置的设置。

items.source: Copy configuration from the other config object.
items.translation: 从其他配置对象复制配置。

items.source:
Return whether the AOP proxy will expose the AOP proxy for
each invocation.
items.translation: 返回每次调用时 AOP 代理是否暴露 AOP 代理。

items.source: Return whether the config is frozen, and no advice changes can be made.
items.translation: 返回配置是否已冻结，且无法再进行任何建议更改。

items.source: Return whether proxies should perform aggressive optimizations.
items.translation: 返回代理是否应执行激进的优化。

items.source: Return whether to proxy the target class directly as well as any interfaces.
items.translation: 返回是否直接代理目标类以及任何接口。

items.source:
Convenience superclass for configuration used in creating proxies,
to ensure that all proxy creators have consistent properties.
items.translation: 用于创建代理的便捷父类，以确保所有代理创建器具有一致的属性。

items.source:
Set whether the proxy should be exposed by the AOP framework as a
ThreadLocal for retrieval via the AopContext class.
items.translation: 设置是否由 AOP 框架将代理作为 ThreadLocal 暴露，以便通过 AopContext 类进行检索。

items.source: Set whether this config should be frozen.
items.translation: 设置是否冻结此配置。

items.source: Set whether proxies should perform aggressive optimizations.
items.translation: 设置代理是否执行激进的优化。

items.source:
Set whether to proxy the target class directly, instead of just proxying
specific interfaces.
items.translation: 设置是直接代理目标类，而不仅仅是代理特定接口。

items.translation: `toString` 在类 `Object` 中
